title.narrative: Citizen Science on Natural Disaster: Raising Public Awareness through the Engagement of Vulnerable Groups into Inclusive Disaster Risk Reduction

description.narrative: In the practice of citizen science, the way that physical, social, and digital infrastructures mediate citizen and communities to respond the natural disasters. As a consequence, reaching out these goals would have support poverty eradication and empowerment toward vulnerable groups on the disaster risk reduction context. Through this program, it will implement to the citizen science that targeted communities at large in natural disaster prone-areas, the management of citizen science through innovation and preparedness that targeted the youth as a force during the digital age in post natural disasters, and capacity building to bounce back better that targeted the vulnerable groups particilarly people who become physically disables in post natural disasters. The goals are to raise awareness of the types of citizen science on natural disaster and the activities that communities and others have engaged in, to provide guidance on how to design a project on citizen science on natural disaster and identify resources to support activities, and to facilitate partnership between various type of communities and other entities such as governments or research institutions, to carry out citizen science activities.
